properties.description: Runs one DIRECT Module outside a Batch: opens and evaluates the Module Instance in the repository, runs the executable on the Warehouse, and closes the instance with the outcome. Standard DIRECT asset; configure through the DIRECT Variable Library.

activities.name: Open Module
activities.description: Creates and evaluates the Module Instance; returns the Module to run.

activities.name: Run Modules
activities.description: Runs the rollback statements and executables of the Modules on the Warehouse, in sequence, and collects the outcome per Module Instance.

activities.name: Close Module
activities.description: Records the load window and the outcome of the Module Instance.

activities.name: Fail Module
activities.description: Closes the Module Instance as Failure when the executable could not be run.
